rationale: Comparison for unit:evidence.map.value_unique against lean:Common/FiniteMap:FiniteMap.value_unique. The theorem universally quantifies key and value types and both membership witnesses in one FiniteMap, concluding equality of values. Its signature has no ordering or decidable-equality assumptions; the unique-key invariant from evidence.map supplies the intended restriction. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:evidence.map.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
